items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates that Bob Crosby, Bing, and Mildred were in the same group, but does not state a personal relationship with Bing Crosby himself.

ctx.x: Mildred passed away a good thirty years ago. While she was here, it was always the same thing, it was always at the request of someone. She was a real artist, and Red is too.
Do you know Mildred's story of Bing Crosby?
